From: Erin Moore <erin.moore@aurorahealthcare.com>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire & artifact request for Aurora procurement

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Procurement is moving quickly and they've asked us to share a completed SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) questionnaire plus the supporting artifacts for our security review. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by end of next week (May 28):

- Completed SIG spreadsheet (we'll review internally)
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok)
- Pen test summary or executive findings
- ISO statements (if available)
- High-level security deck for our InfoSec team

If any of those will take longer, please flag what the blocker is and give an estimated delivery date. Also, is there an existing shared link or drive location you prefer for secure upload?

Appreciate it — Erin
Erin Moore
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Healthcare
ern.moore@aurorahealthcare.com

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire & artifact request for Aurora procurement

Hi Erin — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of where we are and what you can expect: 

- SOC 2 Type II (most recent) — we have a redacted PDF we can share by Friday, May 21.
- Pen test summary — coordinating with our provider; expect an executive summary by Monday, May 24.
- ISO statements — we have our ISO27001 statement; I'll attach the official statement (redwood).
- Security deck — we have a concise deck tailored to procurement reviews; will include that.
- SIG spreadsheet — we can complete the SIG template and drop as an .xlsx by Friday, May 28 at the latest; if we can accelerate, we will.

I'm CC'ing Nikhil (security) to confirm there are no blocking data-sanitization steps for the SOC2/pen test files. If procurement needs stricter transfer controls (SFTP or encrypted Drive folder), let us know and we'll comply.

Proposed delivery plan:
- May 21: SOC2 (redacted PDF), ISO27001 statement, security deck link
- May 24: Pen test executive summary
- May 28: Completed SIG spreadsheet

Does that timeline work for Aurora's team? If you need anything earlier for an audit date, we'll prioritize.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
